assessments.item_label: Platinum-to-carbon mass ratio
assessments.applied_correction: Canonicalized as Platinum-to-carbon mass ratio; mapping decision new_h2kg_term.
assessments.rationale: Mass ratio of platinum catalyst to carbon support in the catalyst layer.

assessments.item_label: Ionomer-to-carbon ratio
assessments.applied_correction: Canonicalized as Ionomer-to-carbon ratio; mapping decision existing_h2kg_mapping.
assessments.rationale: Mass ratio of dry ionomer to carbon support in the catalyst layer.

assessments.item_label: Ionomer-catalyst dispersion parameter
assessments.applied_correction: Mapping decision new_h2kg_term; no label correction required.
assessments.rationale: Parameter describing the tendency of ionomer to spread over the platinum-on-carbon surface rather than form larger ionomer aggregates.

assessments.item_label: Total pore volume
assessments.applied_correction: Mapping decision existing_h2kg_mapping; no label correction required.
assessments.rationale: Total volume of void space within a specified material or structure.

assessments.item_label: CCL primary-pore volume fraction
assessments.initial_decision: Volume fraction of primary pores inside CCL | Parameter
assessments.applied_correction: Canonicalized as CCL primary-pore volume fraction; mapping decision new_h2kg_term.
assessments.rationale: Fraction of the total pore volume assigned to primary pores in the ionomer-free platinum-on-carbon structure of a cathode catalyst layer.

assessments.item_label: CCL secondary-pore volume fraction
assessments.initial_decision: Volume fraction of secondary pores inside CCL | Parameter
assessments.applied_correction: Canonicalized as CCL secondary-pore volume fraction; mapping decision new_h2kg_term.
assessments.rationale: Fraction of the total pore volume assigned to secondary pores in the ionomer-free platinum-on-carbon structure of a cathode catalyst layer.

assessments.item_label: CCL primary-pore geometric-mean radius
assessments.initial_decision: Geometric mean pore radius for CCL primary pores | Parameter
assessments.applied_correction: Canonicalized as CCL primary-pore geometric-mean radius; mapping decision new_h2kg_term.
assessments.rationale: Geometric mean, equal to the median, of the volume-weighted lognormal pore-radius distribution for primary pores in a cathode catalyst layer.

assessments.item_label: CCL secondary-pore geometric-mean radius
assessments.initial_decision: Geometric mean pore radius for CCL secondary pores | Parameter
assessments.applied_correction: Canonicalized as CCL secondary-pore geometric-mean radius; mapping decision new_h2kg_term.
assessments.rationale: Geometric mean, equal to the median, of the volume-weighted lognormal pore-radius distribution for secondary pores in a cathode catalyst layer.

assessments.item_label: CCL primary-pore logarithmic radius deviation
assessments.initial_decision: Logarithmic standard deviation of CCL primary-pore radii | Parameter
assessments.applied_correction: Canonicalized as CCL primary-pore logarithmic radius deviation; mapping decision new_h2kg_term.
assessments.rationale: Dimensionless standard deviation in the volume-weighted lognormal distribution of primary-pore radii, calculated using the natural logarithm.

assessments.item_label: CCL secondary-pore logarithmic radius deviation
assessments.initial_decision: Logarithmic standard deviation of CCL secondary-pore radii | Parameter
assessments.applied_correction: Canonicalized as CCL secondary-pore logarithmic radius deviation; mapping decision new_h2kg_term.
assessments.rationale: Dimensionless standard deviation in the volume-weighted lognormal distribution of secondary-pore radii, calculated using the natural logarithm.

assessments.item_label: Carbon-support-induced ionomer alignment degree
assessments.applied_correction: Canonicalized as Carbon-support-induced ionomer alignment degree; mapping decision new_h2kg_term.
assessments.rationale: Degree of molecular alignment induced in the adjacent ionomer film by the carbon-support surface.

assessments.item_label: Platinum-surface-induced ionomer alignment degree
assessments.applied_correction: Canonicalized as Platinum-surface-induced ionomer alignment degree; mapping decision new_h2kg_term.
assessments.rationale: Degree of molecular alignment induced in the adjacent ionomer film by the platinum surface.

assessments.item_label: Limiting ionomer alignment degree
assessments.applied_correction: Canonicalized as Limiting ionomer alignment degree; mapping decision new_h2kg_term.
assessments.rationale: Limiting degree of ionomer molecular alignment in a thick film where the influence of the platinum-on-carbon surface is negligible.

assessments.item_label: Carbon-support water contact angle
assessments.applied_correction: Canonicalized as Carbon-support water contact angle; mapping decision new_h2kg_term.
assessments.rationale: Water contact angle of the bare carbon-support surface used to describe its intrinsic wettability.

assessments.item_label: Platinum-surface water contact angle
assessments.initial_decision: Catalyst active particle contact angle | Property
assessments.applied_correction: Canonicalized as Platinum-surface water contact angle; mapping decision new_h2kg_term.
assessments.rationale: Water contact angle of the bare platinum surface used to describe its intrinsic wettability.

assessments.item_label: Ideal hydrophilic ionomer contact angle
assessments.initial_decision: Ideal hydrophilic ionomer contact angle | Parameter
assessments.applied_correction: Mapping decision new_h2kg_term; no label correction required.
assessments.rationale: Limiting water contact angle of an ideally hydrophilic aligned ionomer surface used as the hydrophilic endpoint of the model wetting relation.

assessments.item_label: Ideal hydrophobic ionomer contact angle
assessments.initial_decision: Ideal hydrophobic ionomer contact angle | Parameter
assessments.applied_correction: Mapping decision new_h2kg_term; no label correction required.
assessments.rationale: Limiting water contact angle of an ideally hydrophobic aligned ionomer surface used as the hydrophobic endpoint of the model wetting relation.

assessments.item_label: Initial ionomer film thickness
assessments.applied_correction: Canonicalized as Initial ionomer film thickness; mapping decision new_h2kg_term.
assessments.rationale: Limiting effective thickness of the ionomer film on the covered platinum-on-carbon surface as ionomer loading approaches zero, representing the characteristic thickness of the first deposited ionomer layer.

assessments.item_label: Equivalent ionomer patch radius
assessments.applied_correction: Mapping decision new_h2kg_term; no label correction required.
assessments.rationale: Equivalent radius representing the characteristic size of finite ionomer patches distributed over the secondary-pore surface.

assessments.item_label: Platinum particle radius
assessments.applied_correction: Canonicalized as Platinum particle radius; mapping decision new_h2kg_term.
assessments.rationale: Radius of a platinum catalyst particle used to characterize particle geometry.

assessments.item_label: Surface tension
assessments.initial_decision: Surface tension of water at T = 353 K | Property
assessments.applied_correction: Canonicalized as Surface tension; mapping decision existing_h2kg_mapping.
assessments.rationale: Interfacial free energy per unit area associated with the surface of a liquid.

assessments.item_label: Dry ionomer density
assessments.applied_correction: Canonicalized as Dry ionomer density; mapping decision new_h2kg_term.
assessments.rationale: Mass density of dry ionomer used to convert ionomer mass into ionomer volume.

assessments.item_label: Platinum density
assessments.applied_correction: Canonicalized as Platinum density; mapping decision new_h2kg_term.
assessments.rationale: Mass density of platinum used to relate platinum loading to the amount and surface coverage of catalyst particles.

assessments.item_label: Carbon density
assessments.applied_correction: Canonicalized as Carbon density; mapping decision new_h2kg_term.
assessments.rationale: Mass density of the carbon-support material.

assessments.item_label: Capillary-pressure axis data
assessments.initial_decision: Capillary pressure range for WRC | Data
assessments.applied_correction: Canonicalized as Capillary-pressure axis data; mapping decision new_h2kg_term.
assessments.rationale: Array of capillary-pressure values used as the pressure axis for evaluating a cathode-catalyst-layer water-retention curve.

assessments.item_label: CCL water-saturation data
assessments.initial_decision: CCL water saturation for WRC | Data
assessments.applied_correction: Canonicalized as CCL water-saturation data; mapping decision new_h2kg_term.
assessments.rationale: Array giving the fraction of cathode-catalyst-layer pore volume flooded with liquid water at each capillary pressure in the water-retention curve.

assessments.item_label: CCL accessible primary-pore volume fraction
assessments.initial_decision: CCL fraction of primary pores | Property
assessments.applied_correction: Canonicalized as CCL accessible primary-pore volume fraction; mapping decision new_h2kg_term.
assessments.rationale: Normalized fraction of the remaining accessible cathode-catalyst-layer pore volume belonging to primary pores after accounting for ionomer filling.

assessments.item_label: CCL accessible secondary-pore volume fraction
assessments.initial_decision: CCL fraction of secondary pores | Property
assessments.applied_correction: Canonicalized as CCL accessible secondary-pore volume fraction; mapping decision new_h2kg_term.
assessments.rationale: Normalized fraction of the remaining accessible cathode-catalyst-layer pore volume belonging to secondary pores after accounting for ionomer filling.

assessments.item_label: CCL effective ionomer coverage
assessments.applied_correction: Mapping decision new_h2kg_term; no label correction required.
assessments.rationale: Fraction of the total secondary-pore surface covered by ionomer in a cathode catalyst layer.

assessments.item_label: Equivalent ionomer film thickness
assessments.initial_decision: CCL ionomer effective film thickness | Property
assessments.applied_correction: Canonicalized as Equivalent ionomer film thickness; mapping decision existing_h2kg_mapping.
assessments.rationale: Effective uniform thickness of the ionomer film obtained from its volume and the secondary-pore area it covers.

assessments.item_label: CCL primary-pore specific surface area
assessments.initial_decision: CCL pore area of primary pores | Property
assessments.applied_correction: Canonicalized as CCL primary-pore specific surface area; mapping decision new_h2kg_term.
assessments.rationale: Specific surface area of the primary-pore domain of the ionomer-free reference structure per unit carbon mass, calculated from the primary-pore size distribution.

assessments.item_label: CCL secondary-pore specific surface area
assessments.initial_decision: CCL pore area of secondary pores | Property
assessments.applied_correction: Canonicalized as CCL secondary-pore specific surface area; mapping decision new_h2kg_term.
assessments.rationale: Specific surface area of the secondary-pore domain of the ionomer-free reference structure per unit carbon mass, calculated from the secondary-pore size distribution.

assessments.item_label: CCL total-pore specific surface area
assessments.applied_correction: Canonicalized as CCL total-pore specific surface area; mapping decision new_h2kg_term.
assessments.rationale: Total specific surface area of the primary- and secondary-pore network of the ionomer-free cathode-catalyst-layer reference structure per unit carbon mass.

assessments.item_label: CCL ionomer alignment degree
assessments.initial_decision: CCL degree of alignment of ionomer film | Property
assessments.applied_correction: Canonicalized as CCL ionomer alignment degree; mapping decision new_h2kg_term.
assessments.rationale: Degree of alignment of ionomer sidechains and backbones after accounting for the platinum-on-carbon surface and the decay of alignment with film thickness.

assessments.item_label: Platinum-carbon pore-wall contact angle
assessments.initial_decision: CCL contact angle of PtC pore wall | Property
assessments.applied_correction: Canonicalized as Platinum-carbon pore-wall contact angle; mapping decision new_h2kg_term.
assessments.rationale: Effective water contact angle of the uncovered platinum-on-carbon pore wall determined from the surface contributions of platinum and carbon.

assessments.item_label: Ionomer-coated pore-wall contact angle
assessments.initial_decision: CCL contact angle of ionomer pore wall | Property
assessments.applied_correction: Canonicalized as Ionomer-coated pore-wall contact angle; mapping decision new_h2kg_term.
assessments.rationale: Effective water contact angle of an ionomer-coated pore wall determined by the ionomer degree of alignment.

assessments.item_label: CCL mean contact angle
assessments.applied_correction: Mapping decision new_h2kg_term; no label correction required.
assessments.rationale: Arithmetic mean of local cathode-catalyst-layer pore contact angles, with primary- and secondary-pore distributions weighted by their shares of total pore volume remaining after ionomer filling.

assessments.item_label: CCL hydrophilic-pore mean contact angle
assessments.initial_decision: CCL mean contact angle of HI pores | Property
assessments.applied_correction: Canonicalized as CCL hydrophilic-pore mean contact angle; mapping decision new_h2kg_term.
assessments.rationale: Pore-volume-weighted arithmetic mean of contact angles below 90 degrees, considering cathode-catalyst-layer pore volume remaining after ionomer filling.

assessments.item_label: CCL hydrophobic-pore mean contact angle
assessments.initial_decision: CCL mean contact angle of HO pores | Property
assessments.applied_correction: Canonicalized as CCL hydrophobic-pore mean contact angle; mapping decision new_h2kg_term.
assessments.rationale: Pore-volume-weighted arithmetic mean of contact angles above 90 degrees, considering cathode-catalyst-layer pore volume remaining after ionomer filling.

assessments.item_label: CCL secondary-pore hydrophobic volume fraction
assessments.initial_decision: CCL hydrophobic fraction of secondary pores | Property
assessments.applied_correction: Canonicalized as CCL secondary-pore hydrophobic volume fraction; mapping decision new_h2kg_term.
assessments.rationale: Fraction of secondary-pore volume with hydrophobic wetting behavior, corresponding to contact angles greater than 90 degrees.

assessments.item_label: Pore-radius axis data
assessments.applied_correction: Canonicalized as Pore-radius axis data; mapping decision new_h2kg_term.
assessments.rationale: Array of pore-radius values used as the size axis for evaluating cathode-catalyst-layer pore-size and contact-angle distributions.

assessments.item_label: CCL refined pore-size-distribution data
assessments.initial_decision: CCL refined pore size distribution | Data
assessments.applied_correction: Canonicalized as CCL refined pore-size-distribution data; mapping decision new_h2kg_term.
assessments.rationale: Normalized pore-volume density per natural-logarithmic interval of pore radius, combining primary and secondary pores after accounting for ionomer filling.

assessments.item_label: Contact-angle cosine axis data
assessments.applied_correction: Canonicalized as Contact-angle cosine axis data; mapping decision new_h2kg_term.
assessments.rationale: Array of contact-angle cosine values used as the angular axis for evaluating the cathode-catalyst-layer contact-angle distribution.

assessments.item_label: CCL contact-angle-distribution data
assessments.applied_correction: Canonicalized as CCL contact-angle-distribution data; mapping decision new_h2kg_term.
assessments.rationale: Normalized cathode-catalyst-layer contact-angle distribution on the specified cosine grid, combining primary- and secondary-pore contributions.
